heading: Nonvoting stock
lead: Stock not held by member banks shall not be entitled to voting power.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section is comprised of the eleventh par. of section 2 of act Dec. 23, 1913. For classification of other pars. of section 2 of this Act, see Codification note set out under section 222 of this title.
